source: Generated by cmd/gen-cdu-reference from sim-api 0abeed1d9382d0fc70b0a75bdd9c678b04fca81e and simulator-ui-kit 06ab3de5fb60b488f216a51ad8d31cda01dce46f; do not edit.

AccountDetails.purpose: The read-only details of one account name + currency pair of an actor: status, Fact / Plan sides, limits, formula and balance.

AccountTemplate.purpose: The Account Template constructor with a live preview.

examples.name: New account template
examples.description: Let the user design a new account template on the constructor tab; it is created on first save.

AccountTemplatesList.purpose: The workspace’s Account Templates, with tabs, search and filters.

examples.name: Custom templates, read-only
examples.description: Browse the workspace's own account templates without row selection or a create button.

ActorAccounts.purpose: One actor’s ledger accounts (Plan / Fact / Margin), in folders.

examples.name: Actor accounts, read-only panel
examples.description: Show the accounts of the actor a page is about in a narrow side panel, without editing.

ActorFilterEditor.purpose: Creates or edits a saved actor filter in the stored actor-filter format; it opens through its `openCreate` / `openEdit` api methods, or in page flow when embedded.

examples.name: Edit a filter inline
examples.description: Embed the editor in the page to edit the saved filter the page is about.

ActorList.purpose: A paginated table of actors with search, filters and realtime updates.

examples.name: Graphs with a custom row action
examples.description: List the workspace's graphs and add an «Open» item to each row's menu that the page binds through `rowAction`.

examples.name: Page handles the row click
examples.description: Turn off the built-in actor panel and drill-in, and let the page decide what a click and a double click do by binding `actorClick` / `actorDoubleClick`.

ActorView.purpose: The opened-actor shell: a header plus sections. Custom tabs take their content from named slots.

examples.name: Actor side panel
examples.description: Open an actor in a narrow, closable panel with an extra tab for its files.

Attachments.purpose: The files of an actor or of the workspace, as a table or a grid.

examples.name: One actor's files in a panel
examples.description: Show the files attached to the actor a page is about in a narrow side panel, read-only.

Avatar.purpose: A user or entity avatar: an image (`src`), initials from `value`, or an icon, optionally with a badge.

AvatarGroup.purpose: An overlapping row of avatars; each avatar is an `Avatar` child.

Badge.purpose: A small status or count label, optionally with an icon given by name.

Banner.purpose: An inline status message: its text is the node's children, and closing it fires `onClose`.

Bleed.purpose: Pulls its content outward with negative margins, past the surrounding padding.

Breadcrumbs.purpose: A breadcrumb trail. Each item is `{ id, label, icon? }`; `onChange` reports the chosen item.

Button.purpose: A button. `title` is the label; icons are given by name. Its events carry the DOM event.

ButtonGroup.purpose: A row of grouped buttons; each button is a `Button` child with its own props.

CallTranscription.purpose: The live transcript of a meeting: the newest lines first, earlier ones on request, meeting events in the reader's language.

Card.purpose: A surface container with an optional `title`; its content is the node's children.

ChangeJournal.purpose: The change-history feed of one object.

examples.name: Actor change history
examples.description: Show who changed what on the actor a page is about, newest first, in a tinted side panel.

Chart.purpose: A saved chart (a Dashboards entry), rendered live.

examples.name: Dashboard with drill-down
examples.description: Render a dashboard actor and let a click on a metric list the transactions behind it.

ChatWidget.purpose: A personal widget conversation with configurable labels, standard expiry and a history of previous dialogs.

Checkbox.purpose: A checkbox: `value` is the checked state, and the label comes from its children.

Chip.purpose: A compact tag or filter chip; `title` is its text, and icons are given by name.

Col.purpose: A column of a `Row` grid: its span, offset and order, per breakpoint if needed.

ColorPalette.purpose: The theme hue picker with the user’s saved custom colour palette.

examples.name: Clearable colour picker
examples.description: Let the viewer pick a colour for something on the page from a few theme hues or their saved colours, or clear it.

ColorPicker.purpose: A colour picker; `value` is a `#RRGGBBAA` hex string.

CreateAccount.purpose: The create-account dialog for an actor.

examples.name: Inline account form
examples.description: Embed the create-account form in the page for the actor it is about, skipping the access step.

CreateActor.purpose: The actor create / edit panel, built from the template’s fields.

examples.name: Edit an actor inline
examples.description: Embed the actor form in the page to edit the actor the page is about.

CreateEvent.purpose: Creates or edits an Event actor, optionally with a meeting.

examples.name: Start from the basic template
examples.description: Open the create-smart-form dialog with the basic template preselected, from a button that calls `open`.

CreateTransaction.purpose: Writes a transaction or a transfer between accounts.

examples.name: Credit an actor inline
examples.description: Embed a transaction form that opens on crediting the actor the page is about.

DashboardWizard.purpose: The chart-authoring modal; it opens through its `openCreate` / `openEdit` api methods.

DatePicker.purpose: An always-open calendar for picking a date or a range.

Divider.purpose: A separator line, optionally with text — its children — in the middle.

DragDropZone.purpose: A drop target for files; its content is the node's children, and the drop is the `onDrop` event.

ESign.purpose: A legal e-signature of an actor's document through the host's signing widget: a status button, the sign-queue chip, or nothing, with signing started by any component.

EventsCalendar.purpose: The workspace's events as a month, week, day or agenda calendar.

examples.name: Team calendar
examples.description: The workspace's events by month, with week, day and agenda one click away.

examples.name: My meetings this week
examples.description: Only scheduled meetings, opening on the week.

examples.name: Read-only agenda
examples.description: A compact upcoming list without creating events.

examples.name: Read-only events feed
examples.description: List the workspace's events in short pages without the «Add event» button.

examples.name: Events under their streams
examples.description: The events feed with its streams bar — To Sign, To Do, Live and your own streams pick what it lists.

examples.name: Events as a calendar
examples.description: The events feed with a List | Calendar switch, opening on the calendar.

examples.name: Chats under their streams
examples.description: The chat list with All / Direct / Groups and the contact book; a chat opens beside the list.

Form.purpose: Holds the values of the fields it declares in `vm.<valueKey>`, for `form.validate`, `form.submit` and `form.reset`.

examples.name: Embedded graph preview
examples.description: Show a graph without the coordinate rulers or the diagnostics panel, for a compact surface inside a page.

GuestJoin.purpose: The page a public link opens: join an actor at once, or wait for its host.

examples.name: Join by link
examples.description: The page a public link opens: join at once, or wait for the host.

HubNavigation.purpose: Host introduction/footer are named slots; navigation data stays serializable.
HubNavigation.children: header — any children; footer — any children

Icon.purpose: An icon, given by its registry `name`.

ImportExport.purpose: Background import and export tasks of the workspace.

examples.name: Import and export tasks
examples.description: Give a workspace admin page the import drop zone, the export queue and their task history, 20 rows per page.

Label.purpose: Text: `text` is what it shows, in the theme's sizes, weights and colours.

List.purpose: A list of opaque `dataSource` items; primitives print as text, objects as JSON.

MeetingAgenda.purpose: The agenda of a meeting: topics in speaking order, each with the people who speak to it.

MeetingCallButton.purpose: A button that calls colleagues: it rings the people in `callTo` and opens the call's room once they answer.

MeetingRoom.purpose: A meeting room with pre-join device controls, a shared call session, participants and call actions.

Modal.purpose: A modal dialog. The body is the node’s children; `header` carries the title and icon.

NavMenu.purpose: A navigation menu built from `items`; `onSelect` reports the chosen key.

NotificationCenter.purpose: The user's notifications per workspace, live: a bell with the unread count or the feed in the page; opening one reads its actor's entries.

examples.name: Bell in the header
examples.description: A bell with the unread count that opens the feed of the active workspace.

examples.name: Every workspace
examples.description: The feed of every workspace with news, laid out in the page.

NotificationSettings.purpose: The viewer's notification settings in a workspace: what notifies, with timed mutes and per-kind sound, the delivery channels, and which ringtone and sounds play at what volume.

examples.name: Settings page
examples.description: The notification settings of the active workspace.

examples.name: Sounds
examples.description: Opens on the ringtone and notification sounds.

Notifications.purpose: The on-screen container that stacks toasts.

Pagination.purpose: Page navigation for a list; `onChange` reports the chosen page.

Popover.purpose: A floating panel opened from its children, the trigger.

PortalContainer.purpose: Sets where pop-up components inside it render; it takes a single child.

ProgressBar.purpose: A progress bar for a known amount of work.

Quote.purpose: A highlighted quote block; its content is the node's children.

Radio.purpose: A radio group over `options`; `value` is the chosen option.

Reactions.purpose: The comments and reactions thread of an actor.

examples.name: Comments with a light composer
examples.description: Show threaded comments on the actor a page is about, oldest first, with only emoji, files and mentions in a collapsed composer.

Row.purpose: A grid row: gutter, alignment and wrapping for its `Col` children.

SearchEntity.purpose: Global search over actors, forms, accounts and users.

examples.name: Search actors and templates
examples.description: A header search limited to actors and account templates, whose pick the page binds through `resultSelected`.

Select.purpose: A select / dropdown over `options`; `onChange` emits `{ value }`.

SelectAccount.purpose: Picks an account name and currency pair.

examples.name: Several account pairs
examples.description: Let the viewer collect several account name and currency pairs, with system accounts shown but not selectable.

examples.name: Template filter
examples.description: A compact Account Template scope for a toolbar filter, with an «All Account Templates» choice.

SelectActor.purpose: An actor picker with recent, by-template and search views, and in-place creation.

examples.name: Pick a dashboard
examples.description: A clearable picker limited to the Dashboards system template that reopens with the dashboard the page already shows.

SelectActorAccount.purpose: Picks one of the account pairs an actor holds.

examples.name: Account of the picked actor
examples.description: Offer the accounts of the actor chosen in a `SelectActor` beside it, for a form that writes money.

SelectActorField.purpose: Picks one of an actor's data fields, from its own form or a linked one.

examples.name: Data field of the picked actor
examples.description: Offer the data fields of the actor chosen in a `SelectActor` beside it — e.g. to bind a data trigger to one.

examples.name: Assign people or groups
examples.description: Pick up to five users or groups as chips, for an assignee or a recipients field.

Sharing.purpose: The access-control editor of one object.

examples.name: Share an actor
examples.description: Manage who can see and change the actor a page is about, with its owner marked in the list.

examples.name: Share a meeting, with a public link
examples.description: The people who can open the meeting, and a link that lets guests in once a host admits them.

Slider.purpose: A slider for one number or a `[min, max]` range.

SmartForm.purpose: An embedded smart form, addressed by `appId`, `actorId` and `rootActorId`.

examples.name: Smart form on an actor
examples.description: Run an actor's smart form, opening it automatically once it scrolls into view.

SmartFormEditor.purpose: Edit a CDU v2 smart form as JSON with a live, read-only preview of the draft.

examples.name: Edit a smart form
examples.description: Open the develop environment of a smart form on its JSON source, with the preview beside it.

Spacer.purpose: Grows to fill the free space of its flex parent.

Splitter.purpose: A resizable split layout; its panels are the node's children.

Stack.purpose: Lays its children out in a row or a column, with a gap between them.

Streams.purpose: The streams bar over the Events or the Chats list: the system streams and your own, with unread counts, Read all, notification menus and Manage streams; for chats the contact book leads the row.

examples.name: Chat streams
examples.description: All / Direct / Groups and your own chat streams.

TabItem.purpose: One tab button of a `Tabs` bar. A leaf: it has no panel and no children.

Table.purpose: A table of `dataSource` rows, shaped by `columns`.

Tabs.purpose: A tab bar; each tab is a `TabItem` child, and `value` is the active one.

TextInput.purpose: A text or number input; `onChange` emits `{ value }`.

ThemePicker.purpose: Lets the viewer switch between the themes the form offers.

Toggle.purpose: An on/off switch: `value` is the state, and the label comes from its children.

Tooltip.purpose: A tooltip around its children; `value` is the tooltip text.

TransactionView.purpose: One ledger transaction opened as a page: amount, status, the accounts it moved, its parameters and linked transactions.

examples.name: Transaction from the page model
examples.description: Show one transaction the page already knows, with a back button the page binds through `back`.

examples.name: One actor's transfers
examples.description: List the transfers that touch the actor a page is about, read-only, 50 rows per page.

examples.name: Form field changes
examples.description: Open on the Form fields tab: the reader picks a template field and sees how its values changed.

TransferView.purpose: One transfer opened as a page: how much moved, its status, author and reference, every `from` / `to` leg and the ledger rows it wrote, with Repeat and Copy link.

Triggers.purpose: The triggers on one actor’s account or data field: attach, create, edit, unlink, and each trigger’s call history.

examples.name: Status-field alerts of the page’s actor
examples.description: Manage the alerts watching the status field of the actor a page is about.

Upload.purpose: A file upload field; `onChange` reports the chosen files.

Webhooks.purpose: The workspace’s webhooks: list, create, edit, delete.

Wordmark.purpose: A responsive brand heading combining a primary name, an accent separator and a lighter domain suffix. Typography and colors follow the active theme.

WorkspaceSidebar.purpose: Workspace navigation as a collapsible side rail or bottom dock, with application shortcuts, workspace selection and the user profile.

WorkspaceSwitcher.purpose: The workspace switcher of the application shell.

examples.name: Sidebar workspace switcher
examples.description: A workspace switcher at the bottom of a sidebar whose panel opens upward, with a localized caption.
